subject: SIG questionnaire & target completion window
messages:
From: Lena Morales <procurement@clearhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <it-security@clearhealth.com>
Date: 2027-07-22T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: SIG questionnaire — target Aug 5 completion?

Hi Karthik,

We're tracking SIG intake for our procurement window and want to confirm Redwood's ability to complete the SIG (v1 PDF attached) and any supporting artifacts by Aug 5. High level asks:
- Completed SIG responses (spreadsheet or XLSX)
- Network diagram showing segmentation and egress controls
- SOC 2 report reference (if available)
- Evidence for encryption at rest/in transit (certs, KMS notes)

Can you confirm who will own the responses and whether the Aug 5 deadline is realistic? If not, propose the nearest achievable date and cadence for weekly check-ins.

Thanks,
Lena Morales
Procurement Manager
ClearHealth
Attachment: SIG-questions-v1.pdf (pdf)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Morales <procurement@clearhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-07-22T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire — target Aug 5 completion?

Hi Lena,

Thanks for the note and the attachment — got the SIG PDF. We can own the responses but will need to coordinate a few SMEs to pull artifacts (network diagram, encryption configs). Tentatively we can complete by Aug 3 to give you a 48-hour review buffer.

Proposed cadence: quick weekly sync (15 minutes) Tuesdays at 10am PT until submission, plus an internal handoff on July 26 for artifact drops.

Marissa — can you take point on evidence assembly (network diagram + KMS notes)? Aditya — can you own technical SIG answers and update the tracker? I'll handle procurement/contract-facing items and final delivery.

Deliverables we plan to drop:
- Completed SIG spreadsheet (XLSX)
- Network segmentation diagram (PDF)
- Evidence bundle (certs, KMS screenshots, policy excerpts)

If that timeline works for you, I'll lock the weekly slot and send the shared Drive link.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-07-23T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire — target Aug 5 completion?

Thanks Karthik — happy to own the evidence pack. Quick status and blockers:
- I have the latest network diagram but need confirmation on public egress rules from infra team (I can call out the missing detail in the diagram).
- KMS screenshots: product/security can provide rotated key IDs and policy snippets, but we need to strip account IDs before sharing.
- SOC 2: we can reference our public SOC 2 Type II report and provide redacted pages for specific controls.

I've started a control tracker (attached: sig-control-tracker.xlsx) mapping each SIG question to owner and evidence artifact. I'll update owners for the controls Aditya will fill in.

Action items I can take immediately:
- Request network egress confirmation from infra (ETA 48 hours)
- Prepare redacted SOC 2 extract for controls 3.2 & 4.1
- Package KMS screenshots once Aditya confirms key IDs to redact

If we aim for Aug 3 submission, July 26 internal handoff is doable.

Marissa
Enterprise Solutions Lead
Redwood Inference
Attachment: sig-control-tracker.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-07-25T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire — target Aug 5 completion?

Looping in a short technical update — I've filled ~70% of the SIG answers and attached the working XLSX (SIG-answers-v2.xlsx). Notes:
- Encryption in transit: TLS 1.2+ enforced, certificate rotation handled via our automation (attached screenshot snippets will be redacted).
- Encryption at rest: we use customer-keyed KMS in dedicated environments for Dedicated accounts; for hosted accounts we use service-managed KMS with strict ACLs.
- Network segmentation: see inline comments in SIG-answers where a network diagram is referenced — Marissa, I'll hand off the diagram on Monday with suggested redactions.

Requesting a quick peer review from Marissa before we push the next draft to Karthik for procurement review.

Attachment: SIG-answers-v2.xlsx (xlsx)

Hi Lena & Samir,

Following our internal workstream, we plan to deliver the completed SIG and supporting artifacts by Aug 3 EOD PT (this gives you the Aug 5 buffer you requested). Here's the delivery plan:

- Aug 3: Drop completed SIG spreadsheet (XLSX) + evidence bundle to shared Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD_example_shared_folder
- Aug 3: Provide redacted SOC 2 pages and network segmentation PDF (network-seg-diagram.pdf)
- Aug 4: Walkthrough call (15 min) to answer any questions and confirm acceptance — propose Aug 4 11am PT (let me know if that conflicts)

If this works, we'll lock the slot and send an access link to the drive. We can also provide a DocuSign or request form for any non-disclosure addendum if required.

Thanks for the collaboration — Marissa and Aditya will be on the walk-through and are CC'd.
